description: §14.8.9 S443 round 6b (L4) — removing a property by a key the compiler cannot read from a row copy may remove a column marker, whatever produced the key (here an ALIAS of Symbol): E-PROTECT-006.
rationale: §14.8.9: the runtime floor is one marker per protected column, read by presence; only a REMOVAL can under-strip. Round 6 recognized three Symbol sources and aliases walked past it (`const S = Symbol; S.for(…)`, `globalThis.Symbol.for`, `const O = Object`, `.bind`, destructuring) — review measured the full row served. The rule now looks at the removal (delete / Reflect.deleteProperty / defineProperty / defineProperties / object-rest exclusion by a non-literal key), not at the key's source.
